opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Scholarship (2027)

amount.raw: A bursary of £9,000 towards the Scholar's study tour and subsistence expenses, plus funding for professional and leadership development

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must work within the farming, food, horticultural, forestry, rural and associated industries or be in a position to influence these industries; aged between 25 and 45 (upper age limit 45 on 31st July in the year of application); no academic qualifications required; well established in their career and three years post tertiary education; resident in the UK and hold a UK passport or work directly for UK agriculture; not in full-time education.
opportunities.summary: Awards approximately 25 individuals each year to research topics of interest in farming, food, horticulture, forestry or any other countryside and ancillary industry, conducting a study tour of no less than 8 weeks anywhere in the world, then presenting findings to the industry.

opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship (2027)

amount.raw: Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000; fully funded including all travel and subsistence, plus £1,000 to part-cover replacement labour cost

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24, open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the industry (for 2027, dairy and pig study tours are planned).
opportunities.summary: Fully funded ~30-day study programme for young people aged 18-24 to develop their understanding of the industry, linking successful applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network, including an induction day in London and stays on farms with Nuffield Scholars.
